Hi Jon,

Thanks for the detail, that error tells us what we need. VREG overheated with that Guru Meditation code points to a failure on the voltage regulator stage of the board, not to your power supply. It is a hardware fault and it is covered under warranty. Please leave the unit unplugged, running it again will not help and could make it worse.

The parcel you just received is the Overclocking add-on from your July order, tracking ····, delivered today. That is the last outstanding item on Shop····, so that order is now complete.

Nothing changes on the replacement NerdOctaxe, and you still do not need to send anything back to us. A colleague picks this up Monday at 10am ET to get the replacement released, and the confirmation and tracking come to you by email as soon as it moves.

Sorry you have had this run of trouble with it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Ahhhh ok. :(  Thanks for the swift response and clarification on whats
happening with this thing.

Hi Jon,

No problem at all, and sorry it turned out to be the board rather than something simple.

Where it stands: the fault has been checked over on our side and confirmed as defective, and the return is with the team for final sign off. They will confirm it by email shortly, with the next step and anything you need to do. You are not waiting on anything from me in the meantime, and the unit should stay unplugged until then.

Your Overclocking add-on is yours to keep using with your other gear in the meantime.

Thanks for being patient with this one, Jon.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
